name: Remote domain settings
description: Lists remote domains with whether automatic forwarding, automatic replies, delivery reports and non-delivery reports are allowed, their out-of-office type, TNEF setting and character sets.

parameters.name: OnlyAutoForwardAllowed
parameters.label: Only domains that allow auto forwarding
parameters.help: Leave out remote domains Exchange reports as blocking automatic forwarding. A domain whose setting is unknown is kept.

prerequisites: ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later installed through your organisation's approved process, and an Exchange role that can read organisation configuration.
limitations: Runtime support follows the ExchangeOnlineManagement module's documented support; not yet tested in a tenant.
The Default remote domain (*) applies to every domain no other remote domain names; precedence between overlapping entries is not worked out here.
Outbound spam policies and mail flow rules can also block automatic forwarding; they are not read, so AutoForwardEnabled True is not proof that forwarding leaves the tenant.
TNEFEnabled returned empty means Exchange leaves TNEF to the sender's Outlook settings and is shown as FollowsClient; one not returned at all is Unknown. A setting returned empty is NotSet.
A true or false value Exchange did not return is shown as Unknown, never as False.
The roles listed follow Microsoft's documentation and have not been confirmed in a tenant.
